headline: Company swings back to profitability
summary_short: YC Inox reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of TWD 0.13, versus a year-ago loss of TWD 0.58 per share.
summary_long: EPS turned positive at TWD0.13, compared with a loss of TWD0.58 in the year-ago quarter. Sequentially, EPS also improved from TWD0.003 in the prior quarter, though that prior-quarter base is near zero and not a meaningful percentage comparison. This is the only KPI on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet data are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
